stem: A facility routes waste carts through the same corridor used for clean propagation inputs. What is the strongest systems concern?
choices: The traffic design creates a recurring cross-zone contamination pathway that should be separated or controlled
The corridor will become too crowded only during harvest
Propagation inputs should simply be moved faster
Waste carts are harmless if emptied daily
rationale: Facility zoning should reduce avoidable movement of higher-risk waste through cleaner production pathways.
